findings.claim: Gas-free disk-seeded cores have H=0 because the normalized grain map excludes H. This includes outer icy cores; there is no distinction between free nebular H and H bound into solid compounds.

Positive envelope mass requires a sufficiently massive core beyond the snowline. With positive luminosity, birth T<170*(1-0.3)^0.25+35=190.49750726887805K, so ordinary core/envelope birth does not simultaneously meet positiveH and225<T<375. Later evolution is not ruled out.

Retained H2O is an escape-capability candidate selected by class/band. Current molecular diagnostic H2O=min(0.5H,2O) is zero whenH=0. The retained label proves neither molecular inventory nor accessible water.

Gradual mass accretion carries no elemental composition. Merge packets can add H-bearing material. A condensation seed carries H but remains a planetesimal/gas-giant-family object unless merged into an existing planet; classifier has no direct planetesimal-to-planet route.

Exact material equality rejects origin during representable mass/composition change; later change retires the account. XUV loss is a possible ordinary mass-changing route without inventory gating. No universal one-tick lifetime follows: below-ULP fluxes may not change stored M, and saved masses were stable across sparse samples.

finite_existing_path.description: A naturally disk-created planet can survive a gentle collision with a smaller H-bearing condensation seed or envelope-bearing body. The existing merge packet carries composition; the integrator mass-weights it. Below700K it strips neither ice volatiles norH/He. A finite gentle encounter can introduce positiveH while a temperate larger survivor remains within225-375K. After the changed material has settled, a subsequent unchanged-material snapshot can pass the proposed signature gate if all event/ecology/temperature/removal checks also hold.
limits: Cold hard impacts above5km/s can shatter; at700K the merger removesC/N and at1500K removesH/He.
The existing planet must be the larger survivor; standalone condensation is not a second planet-production route.
Later radiative warming of an envelope-bearing planet is another code-available thermal route, not a demonstrated full guard match.
This establishes a conditional finite material path, not an observed ordinary trajectory or guarantee of default-run eligibility. No input/world/tuning change was performed.
